issue.title: resolve_agent_page_url has no cache: refreshes the whole family-name registry on every TUI selection (400-800ms)
issue.description:
Discovered during phase bead sase-l6.6 (land phase of epic sase-l6, SASE CONTEXT incremental enrichment) while re-measuring the full detail-header-summary budget on 2026-08-14.

resolve_agent_page_url() (src/sase/ace/tui/models/agent_page_url.py:26), one of the twelve resolvers inside build_detail_header_summary, is not one of epic sase-l6's three targeted stores, but it has no cache at all and measured 400-800ms cold AND warm in the land-phase re-measurement (tests/perf/bench_detail_header_summary.py --include-home), whenever the sampled agent set includes a 'Done' agent that publishes a hosted page (agent_publishes_page() is true). The epic's original plan baseline (2026-08-13) sampled 0.0ms for this resolver because no such agent happened to be in that day's first-20-agents sample -- this is real, previously-unmeasured cost, not a regression from this epic's changes.

ROOT CAUSE: resolve_agent_page_url() calls hosted_link_resolver(...).snapshot_agent_name_registry() (src/sase/sdd/hosted_links.py:107) unconditionally on every call. hosted_link_resolver() itself IS process-cached per (repo_root, project, root) (src/sase/sdd/hosted_links.py:365 factory), but snapshot_agent_name_registry()'s own docstring says it exists to 'refresh family-name state once for a batch of agent-link lookups' -- it assumes its caller batches calls and refreshes once per batch. resolve_agent_page_url() is called once per TUI agent selection (not batched), so every selection of a page-publishing agent re-triggers a full get_reserved_family_names() registry scan with no staleness check across selections.

RELATED: sase-c7 (closed) fixed the same underlying get_reserved_family_names()-is-uncached-per-call problem for the bulk bead-page-association publication path, adding a build-scoped snapshot refreshed once per publication build. That fix does not cover this call site: the TUI's per-agent-selection path was never batched, so it still refreshes on every call.

Scope: give resolve_agent_page_url's registry snapshot the same treatment sase-c7 established (cache/bound the refresh, e.g. TTL'd or per-selection-batch rather than per-call), following this repo's Rust-core-backend-boundary convention if the fix belongs in a shared layer rather than the TUI adapter.

payload.entry: CLOSEOUT sase-mi.7: resolve_agent_page_url uses a store/project/root/freshness-keyed registry snapshot cache, and tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_agent_page_url.py plus registry/header trace coverage passed (35 passed before closeout cleanup; 19 passed after cache-test cleanup). The detail-header benchmark harness was fixed to group variable trace spans by parent span; -m slow benchmark tests passed 2/2. Corrected real-home benchmark: agent_page_url cold p50 8.8ms / max 982.7ms, warm p50 8.4ms / max 9.3ms, replacing the reported 400-800ms warm scan.

Fixed by epic sase-mi phase 4 (commit 517d09b71). resolve_agent_page_url in src/sase/ace/tui/models/agent_page_url.py no longer calls snapshot_agent_name_registry() unconditionally: the snapshot now goes through a process cache keyed by (resolved store root, project, primary root, in-process registry freshness token) with a 30s TTL fallback and a 32-entry bound, so repeated TUI selections reuse it, one project's registry cannot serve another, and the resolver stays best-effort on exception. Invalidation is deterministic rather than time-only: rebuild_name_registry and _save_entries in src/sase/agent/names/_registry.py call invalidate_agent_name_registry_freshness (new src/sase/agent/names/registry_freshness.py), so any reserved-family-name mutation changes the key immediately. No per-keypress stat, glob, subprocess, or lock was added. Measured on the real-home detail-header benchmark after commit daf933aa5 corrected its span grouping: agent_page_url warm p50 8.4ms / max 9.3ms (cold p50 8.8ms / max 982.7ms for the first real scan), against the 400-800ms per-selection scan this bead reported. Verified by the landing agent at HEAD daf933aa5: tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_agent_page_url.py and tests/test_agent_name_registry_reservations.py green in a 381-test focused batch.
